dedupe_keys.name: 名古屋市 地震ハサートマッフ earthquakes and disaster risk and hazard maps

description: 【名古屋市】地震ハザードマップ [earthquakes and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 名古屋市. 本市が平成26年2月に公表した南海トラフで発生する地震の被害想定をもとに、市内各地で想定される震度や液状化の可能性などを示したものです。 南海トラフにおいて千年に一度あるいはそれよりももっと発生頻度が低いが、仮に発生すれば甚大な被害をもたらす地震として「あらゆる可能性を考慮した最大クラス」の地震を想定しています。. Coverage: 名古屋市. The portal files it under the publisher 名古屋市. Its tags are ハザードマップ, 名古屋市, 防災. It offers 2 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2026-06-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
